notes: Measured on lab-02 (Apple Silicon). Gateway built from Sources/, model weights from HF cache.
bf16 base model lacks a chat template; Llama-3.2-Instruct template injected for prompt formatting.
Each request uses a unique [#NNNN] prefix so KV prefix cache is cold per request (cache-miss path).
BatchAssembler: maxBatchSize=8, maxWaitMs=100ms. MLXInferenceEngine actor serializes all inference,
so throughput (tok/s) is stable across concurrency levels while latency scales with batch depth.
